This is mitsuami-linux 1.3.6 from crates.io, based on mitsuami commit
4b139714433b1dbf791ad691cda276c2eea85114. It is vendored to correct
Wayland subsurface positioning when the parent surface does not otherwise
commit after a resize. The crate is distributed under MIT OR Apache-2.0;
license texts are included here. The remaining source is unmodified.
